def design(feats):
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    labs = sorted(set(feats.stratum))
    S = np.ones((n, 1))
    if len(labs) > 1:
        S = np.column_stack([S] + [(np.asarray(feats.stratum) == l).astype(float) for l in labs[1:]])

    def ll(M):
        b = np.zeros(M.shape[1])
        for _ in range(30):
            eta = np.clip(M @ b, -30, 30); mu = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-eta)); w = mu * (1 - mu) + 1e-9
            H = M.T @ (M * w[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(M.shape[1])
            step = np.linalg.solve(H, M.T @ (y - mu)); b += step
            if np.max(np.abs(step)) < 1e-7: break
        mu = np.clip(1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(M @ b, -30, 30))), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
        return float(np.sum(y * np.log(mu) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - mu)))

    R = np.corrcoef(X, rowvar=False)
    def base(sel): return np.column_stack([S] + [X[:, j] for j in sel])
    sel = []
    gates = [0.25 / p, 0.05 / p]
    while len(sel) < MAX_DRIVERS:
        B = base(sel); l0 = ll(B); best, bj = 0, None
        for j in range(p):
            if j in sel or any(abs(R[j, k]) >= 0.6 for k in sel): continue
            g = 2 * (ll(np.column_stack([B, X[:, j]])) - l0)
            if g > best: best, bj = g, j
        a = gates[min(len(sel), len(gates) - 1)]
        if bj is None or stats.chi2.sf(best, 1) > a: break
        sel.append(bj)
    changed = True
    while changed and len(sel) > 1:
        changed = False; lf = ll(base(sel))
        for j in list(sel):
            rest = [k for k in sel if k != j]
            if stats.chi2.sf(2 * (lf - ll(base(rest))), 1) > 0.05 / p:
                sel = rest; changed = True; break
    for i, j in enumerate(list(sel)):
        C = [k for k in range(p) if abs(R[j, k]) >= 0.6 and (k == j or k not in sel)]
        if len(C) < 2: continue
        L = np.array([ll(base(sel[:i] + [k] + sel[i + 1:])) for k in C])
        ok = [C[t] for t in range(len(C)) if L[t] >= L.max() - 2]
        sel[i] = max(ok, key=lambda k: np.sum(R[k, C] ** 2))
    # product / square screen over all pairs (score prescreen, LR confirm)
    B = base(sel); b = np.zeros(B.shape[1])
    l0 = ll(B)
    mu0 = np.full(n, y.mean())
    if B.shape[1] > 1:
        from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
        m = LogisticRegression(C=1e6, max_iter=500).fit(B[:, 1:], y); mu0 = m.predict_proba(B[:, 1:])[:, 1]
    r = y - mu0; w = mu0 * (1 - mu0)
    cand = []
    for a in range(p):
        Z = X[:, a:] * X[:, [a]]
        sc = (Z.T @ r) ** 2 / ((Z ** 2).T @ w + 1e-9)
        for k, s in enumerate(sc):
            c = a + k
            if c != a and abs(R[a, c]) >= 0.6: continue
            cand.append((s, a, c))
    cand.sort(reverse=True)
    npair = p * (p + 1) / 2; prods = []; used = set()
    for s, a, c in cand[:15]:
        if a in used or c in used: continue
        M = np.column_stack([B] + [X[:, j] for j in {a, c} if j not in sel])
        lm = ll(M); g = 2 * (ll(np.column_stack([M, X[:, a] * X[:, c]])) - lm)
        if stats.chi2.sf(g, 1) < 0.002 / npair:
            prods.append((a, c)); used |= {a, c}
            if len(prods) == 2: break
    drivers = list(sel)
    for a, c in prods:
        for j in (a, c):
            if j not in drivers: drivers.append(j)
    drivers = drivers[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    cols = sorted(set(sel) | {j for pr in prods for j in pr})
    return Design(drivers=tuple(ids[j] for j in drivers), columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in cols),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[c]) for a, c in prods), loadings={})
